context: Mei and Asuka discuss a medical book.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (大学院/医学/書籍/経過/筆者) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: この医学の書籍、分かりやすいですね。
lines.en: This medical book is easy to understand.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 筆者が、大学院で長く研究した方です。
lines.en: The author researched long in grad school.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 病気の経過も、丁寧に書かれていますね。
lines.en: The course of illness is carefully written too.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 経過を、図で示しているのが良いですね。
lines.en: It's good that progress is shown in diagrams.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 医学って、奥が深いですね。
lines.style: thoughtful woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 筆者の情熱が、書籍に表れています。
lines.en: The author's passion shows in the book.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 大学院での苦労が、伝わりますね。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良い書籍は、経過を越えて残りますね。
lines.en: A good book endures beyond the passage of time.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm reflective closing clarity throughout
